trigger: Resource Ledger for source_retention_exempt: no fds, handles, threads or locks; locals only (r and pa are expected<optional<string>>, def is a literal pointer, state a string_view of a literal); EchoDatabase& is borrowed; nothing escapes
summary: Resource Ledger row: source_retention_exempt acquires no fd, handle, thread or lock; only scope-owned locals; DB handle borrowed; nothing escapes. Satisfies the policy floor for a C++ diff (G-1).

trigger: A source paused by an agent older than v0.12.0 (paused_at absent or 0) whose _enabled flag is later corrupted to a non-canonical value
summary: source_retention_exempt reads an errored flag with paused_at absent or 0 as never paused, so a source paused before v0.12.0 and never re-configured loses its expired rows if its flag is then damaged; before #1572 they were preserved. Not fixable in code: absent or 0 is exactly the state of a fresh errored never-paused source, and a backfill migration would invent a paused-since time, add a schema step in a file this change does not own and remove the dashboard schema-older-than-server badge. Documented as an accepted residual with the remedy (re-issue configure <source>_enabled=false) in docs/echo-implementer.md and docs/user-manual/upgrading.md.
adjudicated_by: architect (Fable 5.2 Architect of the dev-team run; not the change's author, the engineer wrote the code); Gate 7 standard for a rejected code change on a gating finding
adjudication_rationale: Reach needs three things together: paused before v0.12.0 (current 0.16.0), never re-configured since (every current disable edge stamps paused_at > 0, echo_aggregator.cpp:167), then flag corruption. Anyone who can write echo.db can delete rows directly, so no new capability. Consistent with Q4's accepted tamper-window caveat. Treating absent or 0 as a hold would undo #1572.
waiver_rationale: Accepted residual, not a code fix: HIGH closed by documentation. The caveat and remedy are in docs/echo-implementer.md and docs/user-manual/upgrading.md in this change.

trigger: An errored never-paused source is pruned by retention or budget eviction
summary: #1572 proposed an audit note when an errored source's rows are pruned; only a spdlog::warn exists (one per maintenance pass while the source stays errored and unpaused), with no durable counter in echo.status, and the budget eviction path logs nothing. A true pruned counter needs the plan loop reworked (retention deletes run through execute_atomic_batch with no per-plan row count) plus a new echo.status line, which is new persistent state and a new public contract. Deferred to a follow-up issue covering both retention and budget eviction.

The from_chars parse accepted -0 and 00 as a zero paused_at, releasing the hold on a damaged marker. The plugin only writes the literal 0, so the check is now an exact string compare and -0 and 00 are in the malformed test list.

trigger: The warning at echo_aggregator.cpp:761 fires on each maintenance pass while a source stays errored and unpaused, whether or not a row is pruned
summary: Changelog and user manual said the agent logs a warning on each pass that prunes one; the warning sits before the granularity loop and fires on every pass while the state holds. Wording aligned to the behaviour; the cadence stays because a bad flag is a state the operator must clear and the batch gives no per-plan deletion count to gate on.

trigger: Budget eviction of an errored never-paused source's hourly rows
summary: The budget path evicts errored never-paused hourly rows with no log. Covered by the SRE-1 follow-up issue (durable per-source counter covering retention and budget eviction); a log on this path would fire on every candidate pass, not on deletions.
The Echo missing-anchor decision for paused_at was recorded only in echo-implementer.md; a bullet under the Echo entry in Part 6 now records it.

trigger: Operator reading the upgrade guide's byte-budget note
summary: The byte-budget note said paused or errored sources are never removed, which is false for an errored never-paused source. Reworded to paused sources and sources errored while paused, and a Behaviour change note for #1572 carries the detail and the pre-v0.12.0 caveat.

trigger: Reader of the server-side REST wording
summary: rest-api.md:6258 says a paused or errored source is never pruned; server-side wording, out of scope for this change and deferred to a follow-up issue.

trigger: Operator reading the tamper-window caveat in docs/echo-implementer.md
summary: The text said the rule narrows the tamper window; against the old behaviour (every errored source preserved) it opens a release path (flag set bad with paused_at at 0). Reworded: the release grants nothing a direct row delete does not, and a paused source's hold holds only while its marker is non-zero.
